name: Patrick Mahomes
blurb: Throws from arm angles that don't exist yet. Defensive coordinators cry in the shower.

name: Josh Allen
blurb: A cannon strapped to a fullback. Will hurdle your linebacker, then throw 60 yards off one foot.

name: Lamar Jackson
blurb: Video-game elusiveness. Tacklers grab air and question their life choices.

name: Tom Brady
blurb: Slowest guy at the combine, smartest guy in every stadium. Decides before the snap.

name: Peyton Manning
blurb: Runs the offense like an air-traffic controller. Omaha means whatever he wants it to mean.

name: Michael Vick
blurb: Left-handed lightning. The scramble drill was the play call.

name: Drew Brees
blurb: Too short, said everyone. Surgical accuracy, said the record book.

name: Aaron Rodgers
blurb: Free plays, hard counts, and throws threaded through a keyhole on the run.

name: Cam Newton
blurb: Superman in shoulder pads. Goal-line plan: give it to the quarterback.

name: Russell Wilson
blurb: Extends plays forever, then drops a moonball in the bucket 50 yards away.

name: Kyler Murray
blurb: Pocket-sized rocket. Zero-to-sixty before the edge rusher finishes his first step.

name: Tim Tebow
blurb: Throws like he's pushing a shopping cart. Somehow wins anyway in the fourth quarter.

name: Ryan Leaf
blurb: All the tools, none of the instructions. Scouts are still apologizing.

name: JaMarcus Russell
blurb: Can throw it 70 yards from his knees. Can't find the film room with a map.

name: Johnny Manziel
blurb: Electric in college, chaos in the pros. The money sign was a bit early.

name: Jimmy Clausen
blurb: Five-star recruit, one-star Sundays. A clipboard holder of rare pedigree.

name: Tim Couch
blurb: First overall pick behind an expansion line. Mostly remembers the turf.

name: Jameis Winston
blurb: Every throw is either a touchdown or a souvenir for the other team. 30-for-30.

name: Joe Montana
blurb: Ice in the veins. Points out celebrities in the stands during a Super Bowl two-minute drill.

name: Dan Marino
blurb: Fastest release ever. The ball is gone before the pass rush finishes its stance.

name: John Elway
blurb: Fastball you can hear. Helicopters for first downs when it matters.

name: Steve Young
blurb: Left-handed efficiency machine who runs like a tailback when the pocket dies.

name: Brett Favre
blurb: Gunslinger. Fit it in, fire it in, figure it out later. Playing backyard ball for fun.

name: Randall Cunningham
blurb: The original cheat code. Punts 90 yards on a whim, too.

name: Steve McNair
blurb: Plays through anything. Shakes off sacks like flies and keeps the drive alive.

name: Joe Burrow
blurb: Cool as the other side of the pillow. Throws open receivers who aren't open yet.

name: Justin Herbert
blurb: Built in a lab for throwing a football through a car window from midfield.

name: Jalen Hurts
blurb: Squats a small car. The sneak is basically a guaranteed first down.

name: Ben Roethlisberger
blurb: Tacklers bounce off him. Backyard improviser in a linebacker's body.

name: Philip Rivers
blurb: Sidearm sling, nonstop chatter, never misses a start. Shuffles in the pocket like a dad at a wedding.

name: Matt Ryan
blurb: Matty Ice. Timing, rhythm, and a quick read every snap.

name: Daunte Culpepper
blurb: Power forward playing quarterback. Arm and legs that both bully people.

name: Donovan McNabb
blurb: Scrambles for 14 seconds, finds the guy 50 yards downfield. Repeat.

name: Doug Flutie
blurb: Five-foot-nothing magic. Drop-kicks extra points just because he can.

name: Kurt Warner
blurb: Grocery bagger to MVP. Throws to spots before receivers make their break.

name: Jim Kelly
blurb: Runs the no-huddle like a tough guy from a steel town. Because he is one.

name: Troy Aikman
blurb: Precision passer. Hits the out route on a rope before the corner turns his hips.

name: Dak Prescott
blurb: Fourth-round steal with a linebacker's frame and a point guard's poise.

name: Andrew Luck
blurb: Congratulates the guy who just sacked him, then beats him deep next snap.

name: Baker Mayfield
blurb: Swagger first, questions later. Plays every snap with a chip the size of a Buick.

name: C.J. Stroud
blurb: Throws with anticipation that looks like time travel. Doesn't give the ball away.

name: Tua Tagovailoa
blurb: Quickest trigger in the league. Ball's out before the rush gets a hand up.

name: Jayden Daniels
blurb: Rail-thin track star with a rookie poise that makes vets jealous.

name: Joe Namath
blurb: Guarantees the win, wears the fur coat, throws it deep no matter what.

name: Warren Moon
blurb: Run-and-shoot conductor. Throws 50 times a game and makes it look like catch.

name: Roger Staubach
blurb: Captain Comeback. The Hail Mary was his idea, more or less.

name: Brock Purdy
blurb: Last pick in the draft. Distributes the ball like a point guard and never panics.

name: Ryan Fitzpatrick
blurb: Fitzmagic. Could win you three straight or throw six picks. Beard included.

name: Gardner Minshew
blurb: Mustache, jorts, vibes. Throws a funny ball that keeps working.

name: Kirk Cousins
blurb: Clean pocket, clean numbers. You like that.

name: Vince Young
blurb: Unstoppable when he takes off. Long-striding nightmare for any defense.

name: Robert Griffin III
blurb: Track-star speed and a deep ball. One season of absolute fireworks.
